result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For a small team, I'd recommend **1Password Business** as the best all-round password manager, particularly if you want something secure, easy to administer and straightforward for employees to use.

However, there are a few strong alternatives depending on your budget and how much control you need over access.

## Best password managers for small teams

![Get to know 1Password for Mac | 1Password Support](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/C4U7UvvWr1lsit0fdwRMADZs7wYIji_AIA_d_hCeSHTTS1dPoJwwNeSzAPqWszRkpvDsM-p6I-6bznHJsD41eDQWYBj0MySy4qOfvgyzlD_4z3rPSGN9LVxo1hBQTb8qLml3yarSFkZEwcSqyJe7UAnBKtGHsXMSYuWNAwGS3UO1kE8Ogcbnaa14C9ioehoa?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password**

(Best overall)

From \$24.95/month for 10 users, billed annually (Starter Pack)

- Very easy for non-technical employees.
- Shared vaults for departments and projects.
- Granular permissions and access management.
- Security alerts and developer tools.

Best if you want a polished, low-maintenance solution. [1Password business pricing](https://1password.com/pricing/business)

---

**2\. Bitwarden**

(Best value)

From \$4/user/month, billed annually

- Open-source software.
- Shared collections and team passwords.
- Audit and event logs.
- Directory synchronisation and SCIM.

Best if you want excellent security features without spending much. [bitwarden.com](https://bitwarden.com/pricing/business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[bitwarden.com](https://bitwarden.com/en-gb/pricing/business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

- Additional security products available.

Good if you need more structured access management. **4\. Dashlane**

Pricing varies by business plan

- Easy-to-use interface.
- Password health monitoring.
- Secure password sharing.
- SSO and provisioning integrations.

Worth considering if credential risk monitoring is particularly important. [Dashlane pricing](https://www.dashlane.com/pricing)

## My recommendation

I'd narrow it down to 1Password and Bitwarden.

| Consideration | 1Password | Bitwarden |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Ease of use | Excellent | Very good |
| Shared passwords | Yes | Yes |
| Admin controls | Excellent | Very good |
| Budget | Moderate | Lower |
| Open source | No | Yes |


## Three questions to narrow it down

I can make a much more specific recommendation if I know\:

**1\. How many people are in your team?**
